security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI M-mode code executes CSR read/write to menvcfg or menvcfgh on a hart where U-mode is not supported (misa.U=0), violating the normative rule that these registers do not exist without U-mode. The resulting illegal-instruction trap in M-mode is typically unrecoverable.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: CSR access to menvcfg|menvcfgh without prior misa.U-bit existence guard; unconditional csr_read/csr_write(CSR_MENVCFG|CSR_MENVCFGH) in init or HSM context-switch paths
security_spec.summary: OpenSBI must guard menvcfg/menvcfgh CSR accesses with a misa.U-mode existence check, as the spec ties their presence exclusively to U-mode support
